messages:
maria-devsec: Heads-up — proposing we standardize audit event verbs to past-tense ('created', 'updated', 'deleted') for customer-facing events; also want to add `actor_type` and `auth_mechanism` fields. Thoughts? This touches RBAC delta events and KMS envelope logs.

kevin-eng: sounds reasonable. quick q: will `resource` still be free-text? we probably need `resource_type` + `resource_id` to keep SIEM friendly.

sasha-privacy: prefer `resource_type`/`resource_id` + keep customer-facing names short. double-check PII in resource_id before exposing.

jonathan-plat: RBAC team: we need a mapping table old_verbs -> new_verbs for rollout. plan: accept both for 90 days and emit deprecation warning in logs.

maria-devsec: ok plan: add schema header `audit_schema: v2`. We should include KMS key_id in server-internal events only, not customer-facing logs. @kevin-eng can you check Dedicated/Private deployment implications?

kevin-eng: yep. For Private we must not leak key_id in telemetry; propose `hashed_kms_id` (sha256) for correlation without exposing raw key. will open PR to add `hashed_kms_id`. :+1:

audit-bot: Draft uploaded: https://go/repo/audit-schema/v2 diff.automerged

sasha-privacy: FYI I'll run privacy review on sample events. please add examples for RBAC `role_grant` and `role_revoke` events.

jonathan-plat: I'll coordinate SDK aliasing for old verbs. Action items: kevin open PR, maria write rollout doc, sasha privacy review, i'll schedule canary. target dates?

maria-devsec: Target: PR by Thu (2073520000), privacy review by next Tue, canary next Wed. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility :eyes:
